blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite , a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/ .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)可以从他们的培训数据中复制社会陈规定型观念,激发对模型脱轨的广泛研究. 然而,现有方法往往依赖明显的有偏见的例子或预先界定的集团任期替代,使其对措辞敏感,在捕捉不同情况下共有的定型观念概念方面不太有效。 更重要的是,它们通常压制偏颇的产出,而没有明确模拟模型产出与基本定型观念概念之间的统计依赖。 我们建议建立一个轻量级的概念指导框架,以有针对性和有选择性地去除障碍。 Acmite作为结构化的语义概念代表了陈规定型观念,并使用最大边际关联性(MMR)来选择不同的概念来解析. 在相互信息最小化的启发下,它将这种依赖性与符号级的KL差异相近,同时保留任务语义. 一个轻量级的LORA适配器,只有在输入与定型概念足够相似时,才在推论时间用基模型冷冻并激活;否则,原始模型直接使用. 我们评价BBQ、CrowS-Pairs和StreoSet上的Acmite,并评价ARC-Challenge、GSM8K和PIQA的一般能力保护。 三个有限责任管理课程的实验表明,Acmite有效减轻了互补评价格式的性别偏见,同时在与偏见无关的任务上保持竞争力。 匿名代码和数据可查阅https://anonymous.4op.science/r/Acmite-18E2/ 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks ( Song et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2026a ; Zhang, 2026b ) . However, prior studies have shown that these models may still exhibit various forms of social bias ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Hovy and Prabhumoye, 2021 ) . Such biases can be inherited from large-scale pretraining corpora and further influence model predictions and generations, leading to unfair, discriminatory, or stereotype-reinforcing outputs. In high-impact domains such as hiring, education, and healthcare ( Wan et al., 2023 ; Wan and Chang, 2025 ; Warr et al., 2025 ; Omar et al., 2025 ) , these biases may further amplify existing social inequalities. Therefore, effectively mitigating social bias in LLMs has become an important challenge for building fair and reliable AI systems.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)在广泛的自然语言处理任务中表现出了强大的性能(Song等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年;Zhang,2026a;Zhang,2026b). 然而,先前的研究表明,这些模型仍然可能表现出各种形式的社会偏见(Bolukbasi等人,2016年;Hovy和Prabhumoye,2021年)。 这种偏见可以从大规模预先训练公司和进一步影响模型预测和几代人而继承,导致不公平、歧视性或陈规定型强化产出。 在雇用、教育和保健等影响较大的领域(Wan等人,2023年;Wan和Chang,2025年;Warr等人,2025年;Omar等人,2025年),这些偏见可能进一步扩大现有的社会不平等。 因此,有效减轻法学硕士的社会偏见已成为建立公平和可靠的AI系统的一个重要挑战。

blocks.en: Existing studies have proposed various debiasing methods. One line of work intervenes through training data or supervision signals, including counterfactual data augmentation, synthetic debiasing examples, and preference alignment, to encourage fairer model outputs ( Zhao et al., 2018 ; Guo et al., 2022 ; Allam, 2024 ; Han et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . However, these methods typically construct training signals around specific biased instances and rarely abstract the stereotype concepts shared across different expressions, making them sensitive to training distributions and wording. Another line of lightweight approaches uses fairness-oriented prompts, debiasing instructions, or explicit reasoning prompts to constrain model outputs ( Echterhoff et al., 2024 ; Ebrahimi et al., 2024 ; Mohapatra et al., 2024 ) . Although such methods incur relatively low deployment costs, their effectiveness often depends heavily on instruction-following ability and generation stability. Complex multi-step prompting may also lengthen the reasoning process, introduce instruction conflicts and decoding noise, and cause the model to deviate from task evidence, thereby weakening the debiasing effect ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有研究提出了各种脱轨方法. 一线工作通过培训数据或监督信号进行干预,包括反事实数据增强,合成解析实例,以及偏好调整,以鼓励更公平的模型输出(赵等人,2018年;郭等人,2022年;阿拉姆,2024年;韩等人,2024年;张等人,2025年a). 然而,这些方法通常围绕具体偏颇的情况构建培训信号,很少抽象不同表达方式中共有的定型观念概念,使其对培训分布和措辞敏感。 另一种轻量级方法采用面向公平的提示、偏离指示或明确的推理提示来限制模型输出(Echterhoff等人,2024年;Ebrahimi等人,2024年;Mohapatra等人,2024年)。 尽管这些方法的部署费用相对较低,但其效力往往严重取决于遵循教学的能力和生成稳定性。 复杂的多步骤提示也可能延长推理过程,引入指令冲突和解码噪声,并导致模型偏离任务证据,从而削弱解析效应(Chen等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Prior work shows that social bias manifests not only in overtly harmful generations but also in systematic associations between demographic identities and stereotype-related concepts ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Neplenbroek et al., 2025 ) . Bias expressions with different surface forms may arise from the same or related stereotype concepts ( Wan and Chang, 2025 ) ; consequently, optimizing against individual expressions alone may fail to eliminate these shared dependencies. A more direct debiasing objective is therefore to use stereotype concepts as guidance and reduce their influence on model outputs while preserving the model’s general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 以往的工作表明,社会偏见不仅表现在明显有害的几代人身上,而且还表现在人口特征与定型观念相关概念之间的系统联系(Pan等人,2025年;Neplenbroek等人,2025年)。 具有不同表面形态的偏差表达可能来自相同或相关的定型观念概念(Wan and Chang, 2025),因此,单靠单个表达方式优化可能无法消除这些共同的依赖性。 因此,一个更直接的目标,是把定型观念概念作为指导,减少其对模型产出的影响,同时保持模型的一般能力。

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Acmite , a concept-guided mutual information optimization framework for LLM debiasing. Acmite first retrieves stereotype concepts shared across different expressions from two bias datasets. During training, we approximate the conditional mutual information between model predictions and stereotype concepts with token-level KL divergence, thereby reducing the influence of stereotype-related information on model predictions while preserving task-relevant meaning. During inference, Acmite activates the debiasing mechanism only when the input is sufficiently similar to retrieved stereotype concepts. This selective intervention reduces unnecessary changes to bias-unrelated inputs.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提议建立一个概念指导的LLM解密相互信息优化框架。 Acmite首先从两个偏差数据集中检索到不同表达方式中共有的定型观念概念. 在培训期间,我们把模型预测和定型概念之间的有条件相互信息与象征性的KL级差异相近,从而减少定型信息对模型预测的影响,同时保留与任务有关的含义。 在推论期间,Acmite只有在输入与检索到的定型概念足够相似时,才能激活脱钩机制. 这种选择性干预减少了对与偏见无关的投入的不必要的改变.

blocks.en: We evaluate Acmite on three widely used bias benchmarks, BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) , and StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) , and further assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , and PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) . To examine cross-model applicability, we additionally apply Acmite to three model families: Phi-4 ( Abouelenin et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Llama 3.1 ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . Experimental results show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个广泛使用的偏差基准(BBQ(Parrish等人,2022年)),CrowS-Pairs(Nangia等人,2020年)和StereoSet(Nadeem等人,2021年)评估Acmite,并进一步评估ARC-Challenge(Clark等人,2018年),GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)和PIQA(Bisk等人,2020年)的总体能力保存情况。 为了审查跨模型的适用性,我们还将Acmite应用于三个模范家庭: Phi-4(Abouelinin等人,2025年),第203页。 (Yang等人,2025年),和Llama 3.1 (Grattafiori等人,2024年). 实验结果显示,艾克米特在保持与偏见无关的任务的竞争业绩的同时,有效地减轻了性别偏见。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold: 1. Debiasing Framework. We propose Acmite , a concept-guided debiasing framework consisting of stereotype concept retrieval, concept-guided optimization, and retrieval-guided selective activation. 2. Mutual Information Optimization. We introduce a concept-guided conditional mutual information objective, approximated by token-level KL divergence and combined with fair-reference alignment, to reduce stereotypical dependence while preserving task-relevant semantics. 3. Extensive Evaluation. Experiments on six benchmarks and three LLM families demonstrate that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias while maintaining competitive general-task performance.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献有三: 1. 底栖框架。 我们提议Acmite, 一个概念指导的解析框架, 包括刻板概念检索、概念指导优化以及检索指导的选择性激活。 2. 相互信息优化。 我们提出了以概念为指南的有条件相互信息目标,与象征性的KL级差异相近,并与公平参照的一致相结合,以减少陈旧的依赖性,同时保留与任务有关的语义。 3. 广泛评价。 对6个基准和3个LLM家庭的实验表明,Acmite在保持竞争性一般任务业绩的同时,有效地减轻了性别偏见。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Social Bias in Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 大语言模式中的社会偏见

blocks.en: Social bias in language models manifests as systematic associations or behavioral disparities involving gender, race, religion, and other social attributes. It can lead to harmful portrayals or unequal treatment ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) . Early work showed that word embeddings systematically associate gender directions with occupations and other social concepts, demonstrating that stereotypes can be encoded in the representation space ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ) . Such associations may originate from pre-training data, annotation, preference aggregation, or post-training alignment ( Ryan et al., 2024 ; Barnhart et al., 2025 ) . We accordingly view bias as a context-dependent association between social attributes and model behavior, not merely as explicit offensive language.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的社会偏见表现为涉及性别、种族、宗教和其他社会属性的系统性联系或行为差异。 它可能导致有害的描绘或不平等待遇(Gallegos等人,2024年)。 早期的研究表明,嵌入词系统地将性别方向与职业和其他社会概念联系起来,表明陈规定型观念可以在代表空间中编码(Bolukbasi等人,2016年)。 这类协会可能来自培训前数据、注释、偏好汇总或培训后调整(Ryan等人,2024年;Barnhart等人,2025年)。 因此,我们认为偏见是社会属性和模式行为之间的一种依环境而定的联系,而不仅仅是明显的攻击性语言。

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate this association through complementary task formats. CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) and StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) compare model probabilities for stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentences, while BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) jointly measures accuracy and bias in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts. Recent resources extend evaluation to creative generation (CoGS) ( Kumar et al., 2024 ) , description-based demographic concepts (DBB) ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , and fairness-aware generation with factuality considerations in text generation and multi-turn reasoning (F 2 Bench) ( Lan et al., 2025a ) . Multilingual resources, including CBBQ ( Huang and Xiong, 2024 ) , McBE ( Lan et al., 2025b ) , EuroGEST ( Rowe et al., 2025 ) , and IndiBias ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) , further cover Chinese, European, and English–Hindi settings. FSB provides human-rated GPT-generated gender-bias examples ( Hada et al., 2023 ) , whereas GEST pairs neutral scenarios with predefined gender-stereotype categories ( Pikuliak et al., 2024 ) ; we use both as concept sources.
blocks.zh: 现有基准通过互补的任务形式评估这种联系。 CrowS-Pairs(Nangia等人,2020年)和StereoSet(Nadeem等人,2021年)比较了定型和反定型句子的模型概率,而BBQ(Parrish等人,2022年)则在模棱两可和模糊不清的情况下共同测量准确性和偏差. 最近的资源将评价范围扩大到创造性生成(CoGS)(Kumar等人,2024年),基于描述的人口概念(DBB)(Pan等人,2025年),以及在文本生成和多回合推理中考虑到事实的公平生成(F 2 Bench)(Lan等人,2025年a年)。 多种语言资源,包括CBBQ(黄和ion,2024年),McBE(Lan等人,2025年b),EuroGEST (Rowe等人,2025年),和IndiBias(Sahoo等人,2024年),进一步涵盖中文,欧洲和英语–Hindi设置. FSB提供人类等级的GPT生成的性别偏见实例(Hada等人,2023年),而GEST将中性情景与预先定义的性别定型类别(Pikuliak等人,2024年)对齐;我们把两者作为概念来源。

blocks.en: 2.2 Debiasing Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 开发大型语言模型

blocks.en: Existing debiasing methods can be broadly divided into three categories according to where they intervene in the language-modeling process.
blocks.zh: 现行除籍方法可根据其在语言建模过程中的干预方式大致分为三类.

blocks.en: (1) Data- and training-based methods construct balanced examples or alignment signals to modify model behavior. Counterfactual data augmentation swaps demographic terms to create balanced training instances ( Zmigrod et al., 2019 ; Lu et al., 2020 ) ; SynDebias uses synthetic supervision ( Han et al., 2024 ) ; BiasDPO optimizes biased–unbiased preferences ( Allam, 2024 ) ; and GenderAlign provides gender-focused dialogue pairs for alignment ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . HEIMAT elicits biased contexts with heuristic templates and minimizes the Jensen–Shannon divergence between predictions ( Lan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: (1)基于数据和培训的方法构建平衡的示例或对齐信号来修改模型行为. 反事实数据增强交换人口学术语以创造均衡的培训实例(Zmigrod等人,2019年;Lu等人,2020年);SynDebias使用合成监督(Han等人,2024年);BiasDPO优化偏颇-无偏见的偏好(Allam,2024年);GenderAlign提供以性别为重点的对调对话对调(Zhang等人,2025a年)。 HEIMAT以高压模板引出偏颇的背景,并尽量减少预测之间的詹森-沙农差异(Lan等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: (2) Representation- and parameter-level methods directly modify model internals. INLP iteratively removes linearly decodable protected attributes ( Ravfogel et al., 2020 ) , while BiasEdit generates localized parameter updates with lightweight editor networks ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . DSO learns sparse affine steering interventions over internal attention-head representations, providing a lightweight alternative to full-model fine-tuning ( Paes et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: (2)表示式和参数级方法直接修改模型内部. INLP迭代删除线性可解码的保护属性(Ravfogel等人,2020年),而BiasEdit则生成带有轻量级编辑网络的本地化参数更新(Xu等人,2025年). DSO在内部关注头的表述上学习了稀疏的外观指导干预,为全型微调提供了轻量级替代(Paes等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: (3) Inference-time methods modify or screen generations without updating the base model. Axolotl follows a three-stage post-processing procedure that identifies bias in an initial output, proposes a resolution, and guides the model to generate a revised response ( Ebrahimi et al., 2024 ) . BiasFilter instead intervenes during generation by filtering partial outputs with a fairness reward model ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: (3)推论时间方法修改或筛选世代,不更新基模型. Axolotl遵循一个三阶段后处理程序,即识别初始产出中的偏差,提出解析方案,并指导模型生成修订响应(Ebrahimi等人,2024年). 相反,BiasFilter在发电期间进行干预,用公平奖励模式过滤部分产出(Cheng等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Overall, existing methods intervene through training data and objectives, internal representations and parameters, or the generation process. Unlike prior approaches, Acmite treats structured stereotype concepts as explicit intervention signals shared across training and inference. It reduces the dependence of model predictions on retrieved stereotype concepts, guides the optimization with fair references, and selectively activates the learned adapter according to concept relevance.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,现有方法通过培训数据和目标、内部表述和参数或生成过程进行干预。 与以往的做法不同,Acmite将结构化的陈规定型概念视为在培训和推论中共享的明确干预信号。 它减少了模型预测对检索到的定型概念的依赖性,以公平的参考指导优化,并根据概念的相关性有选择地激活已学习的适配器.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Acmite comprises three stages: stereotype concept retrieval, concept-guided adapter optimization, and similarity-based inference routing.
blocks.zh: Acmite由三个阶段组成:定型概念检索,概念引导的适配器优化,以及基于相似性的推论路由.

blocks.zh: 3.1 偏见概念检索

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价细节

blocks.en:
We evaluate gender bias using the gender-specific subsets of three English benchmarks: BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) , and StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) . BBQ evaluates stereotypical reasoning in ambiguous and disambiguated question-answering contexts, while CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet measure stereotypical associations through model likelihoods.
The ideal value is 50 for both the CrowS-Pairs stereotype percentage and StereoSet SS; higher accuracy, LMS, and ICAT are better, while BBQ S S is ideally zero.
blocks.zh:
我们利用三个英语基准的性别分集来评价性别偏见:BBQ(Parrish等人,2022年),CrowS-Pairs(Nangia等人,2020年)和StereoSet(Nadeem等人,2021年)。 BBQ在模棱两可和含糊不清的回答问题时评价陈规定型推理,而CrowS-Pairs和StreoSet则通过模型可能性来衡量定型关联.
CrowS-Pairs定型百分数和StreoSet SS都理想值为50;更高的精度,LMS和ICAT更好,而BBQ S S则理想为零.

blocks.en: We use ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , and PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) to assess capability preservation. We report 5-shot normalized accuracy for ARC-Challenge, 5-shot exact match with flexible extraction for GSM8K, and 0-shot normalized accuracy for PIQA.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ARC-Challenge(Clark等人,2018年),GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),以及PIQA(Bisk等人,2020年)来评估能力保存. 我们报告ARC-Challenge的5发校正精确度,GSM8K的5发校正精确度,PIQA的0发校正精确度.

blocks.en: All evaluations follow standard reproducibility protocols.
blocks.zh: 所有评价都遵循标准的可复制性协议。

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: We compare Acmite with the unmodified backbone and five debiasing baselines. BiasDPO ( Allam, 2024 ) applies preference optimization to biased and unbiased responses; SynDebias ( Han et al., 2024 ) uses synthetic debiasing examples; GenderAlign ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) performs preference alignment with gender-focused chosen–rejected pairs; BiasEdit ( Xu et al., 2025 ) uses localized parameter editing; and DSO ( Paes et al., 2026 ) learns sparse affine steering interventions over attention-head representations. We use identical benchmark splits and metrics for all methods.
blocks.zh: 我们把Acmite与未经修改的骨干和五个减震基线进行比较。 长老会 (Allam, 2024)对偏颇和无偏见的反应实行偏好优化;SynDebias(Han等人, 2024)采用合成去偏好的例子;GenderAlign(Zhang等人, 2025a)实行偏好调整,与选定的注重性别的对子进行偏好调整;BiasEdit(Xu等人, 2025年)采用局部化参数编辑;DSO(Paes等人, 2026年)在注意力点表述上学习了稀薄的芳味指导干预。 我们对所有方法使用相同的基准分数和衡量标准。

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训细节

blocks.en: We conduct the main experiments on Phi-4-mini-Instruct (3.8B) ( Abouelenin et al., 2025 ) and evaluate cross-model applicability on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (4B) ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (8B) ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . Acmite uses Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) for concept retrieval and lightweight LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for debiasing. The resulting repository contains 3,953 stereotype concepts, from which we construct 3,704 training contexts. We use one global inference threshold of τ = 0.60 \tau=0.60 for every backbone and benchmark without dataset-specific adjustment. All experiments are conducted on one NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation GPU. Training and routing hyperparameters are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们对Phi-4-mini-Instruct(3.8B)(Abouelenin等人,2025年)进行主要实验,并评价Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507(4B)(杨等人,2025年)和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(8B)(Grattafiori等人,2024年)的跨模型适用性. Acmite使用Qune3-Embedding-0.6B(Zhang等人,2025年b)进行概念检索和轻量级LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年)进行除颤. 由此产生的储存库包含3 953个定型观念概念,我们从中构建了3 704个培训背景。 我们使用一个全球推论阈值,即每根主干线和基准为0.60\tau=0.60,而不按数据集进行调整。 所有实验都用一个NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU进行。 附录A.1提供了培训和路由超参数。

blocks.en: 5.1 Debiasing Results

blocks.en: Table 1 evaluates bias through question answering, paired likelihood comparison, and sentence-level association. On Phi-4-mini, Acmite obtains the closest-to-zero BBQ bias scores ( − 0.46 -0.46 and 0.58 0.58 ), the highest disambiguated accuracy (90.09), and the best StereoSet SS and ICAT (64.39 and 66.54). It also moves CrowS-Pairs from 59.06 to 55.63, substantially closer to the ideal value of 50. This consistent improvement is important because the three benchmarks expose different model behaviors: selecting an answer under ambiguous evidence, assigning likelihood to stereotypical alternatives, and distinguishing meaningful from unrelated sentences. The gains therefore cannot be attributed solely to a benchmark-specific answer pattern.
blocks.zh: 表1通过回答问题、配对可能性比较和判决层面的联系来评价偏差。 在Phi-4-mini上,Acmite获得最接近零的BBQ偏差分数(−0.46-0.46和0.58 0.58),最高的离谱精度(90.09),最佳的StreoSet SS和 ICAT(64.39和66.54). 它也将CrowS-Pairs从59.06移动到55.63,基本接近50的理想值. 这种一致的改进是重要的,因为三个基准暴露了不同的模式行为:根据模棱两可的证据选择答案,给陈规定型的替代办法分配可能性,以及区别有意义的句子和无关的句子. 因此,收益不能完全归因于具体基准的答案模式。

blocks.en: Qwen3 already exhibits little directional bias on ambiguous BBQ examples, with a base bias score of 0.14, yet its CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet SS scores remain 57.50 and 67.54. This discrepancy reveals that a model can appear nearly unbiased when selecting among explicit answers while still assigning greater probability to stereotypical associations. Acmite preserves Qwen3’s BBQ advantage, reducing the ambiguous bias score to 0.00, while moving CrowS-Pairs to 56.25 and StereoSet SS to 67.02. Its StereoSet ICAT also increases from 60.50 to 61.30 with only a small LMS change. These results support evaluating debiasing across multiple formats instead of using a near-zero score on one benchmark as evidence that the underlying associations have been removed.
blocks.zh: Quen3 已经对模糊的 BBQ 例子显示很少方向偏差, 基础偏差分数为 0.14, 然而它的 CrowS- Pairs 和 Stereo 设定党卫军的分数仍为57.50和67.54. 这种差异表明,在选择明确答案时,一种模式似乎几乎不带偏见,同时仍然给定型协会带来更大的可能性。 Acmite保留了Quen3的BBQ优势,将模棱两可的偏差分数降低到0.00,同时将CrowS-Pairs移动到56.25,将StreoSet SS移动到67.02. 它的立体声 设定 ICAT 也从60.50增加到61.30,只有小的 LMS 更改. 这些成果有助于评价多种格式的去偏差,而不是将一个基准的近零分作为基本协会已被取消的证据。

blocks.en: BiasDPO and training with GenderAlign represent a common preference-based approach to debiasing, in which fairness supervision is expressed through individual prompt–response pairs ( Allam, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Although effective, such supervision does not explicitly connect different expressions of the same stereotype, and its coverage can depend on the diversity of the collected preference pairs. In our experiments, preference-based baselines achieve strong results on some metrics but show less consistent improvements across benchmarks and model families. Acmite instead links individual examples through shared group–attribute concepts extracted from FSB and GEST. Its improvements on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet suggest that extracting shared concepts and combining them with mutual information optimization offers a viable concept-level complement to preference-based alignment.
blocks.zh: BiasDPO和GenderAlign培训代表着一种基于偏好的共同脱贫方法,通过个人即时反应对等(Allam, 2024;Zhang等人,2025a)表达公平监督。 尽管这种监督是有效的,但没有明确将同一定型观念的不同表达方式联系起来,其覆盖面可能取决于所收集的喜好对的多样化。 在我们的实验中,基于优惠的基线在某些衡量标准上取得了强有力的成果,但在基准和模范家庭之间却显示出不太一致的改进。 相反,Acmite通过从FSB和GEST中提取的共享群体属性概念将单个实例联系起来。 它对BBQ,CrowS-Pairs,和StreoSet的改进表明,提取共享概念并将其与相互信息优化相结合,为基于偏好的协调提供了可行的概念层面补充.

On Llama-3.1-8B, Acmite achieves the closest-to-zero BBQ bias scores (0.71 and 2.59), raises disambiguated accuracy to 82.55, lowers CrowS-Pairs from 63.44 to 59.38, and yields the best ICAT of 60.03. blocks.en: Table 4 shows that Acmite maintains competitive general capability. On Phi-4-mini, Acmite scores 61.60 on ARC-Challenge, 81.20 on GSM8K, and 76.93 on PIQA, yielding an average of 73.24 compared with 73.10 for the base model. On Qwen3, it obtains the highest ARC-Challenge score among the evaluated debiasing methods (55.29), remains close to the base model on PIQA (69.42 versus 69.64), and ranks second in average performance at 68.08. On Llama-3.1-8B, Acmite obtains 62.63 on ARC-Challenge, 80.94 on GSM8K, and 79.30 on PIQA, yielding an average of 74.29. It matches the second-best ARC-Challenge result among the debiasing methods and retains more average capability than BiasDPO, GenderAlign, and BiasEdit. Overall, Acmite maintains competitive general-task performance across all three model families while mitigating social bias. Figure 1 summarizes this trade-off using percentage changes relative to Base: the horizontal axis reports average capability change, and the vertical axis reports the mean direction-aware improvement across the eight bias metrics in Table 1 .

blocks.en: 5.3 Case Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 案例研究

blocks.en: Table 3 presents a representative open-ended generation case. The prompt explicitly states that Leah and Mark contributed equally to both product development and business strategy, while the reporter attempts to impose a leader–supporter distinction. The base model initially affirms equality but then assigns product vision to Leah and business operations to Mark, introducing a role division unsupported by the prompt. Acmite instead attributes both vision and execution jointly to the two founders. Importantly, it neither refuses the task nor reverses the proposed hierarchy; it answers the reporter while avoiding an identity-conditioned allocation of responsibilities.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了具有代表性的不限成员名额的一代案例。 即时报道明确指出,莉亚和马克同样为产品开发和商业战略做出了贡献,而记者则试图强加领导者-支持者区别. 基础模型最初肯定了平等,但随后将产品愿景分配给了利亚,将商业业务分配给了马克,引入了一个没有及时支持的角色划分. 相反,Acmite将视觉和执行都归结为两个创始人。 重要的是,它既不拒绝任务,也不推翻拟议的等级制度;它为记者提供答案,同时避免按身份划分责任。

blocks.en: The same qualitative pattern appears in the other selected cases involving a CEO and an executive assistant, competing promotions with childcare constraints, and tied hiring candidates. The base model introduces gendered identities or differentiating attributes absent from the input, whereas Acmite continues the requested scenario using gender-independent descriptions and decision criteria. These additional cases are provided in Appendix B . Together, they complement the benchmark results by showing that Acmite reduces unsupported gender attribution in free-form generation.
blocks.zh: 同样的质量模式出现在其他选定的案件中,涉及一名首席执行官和一名执行助理、因育儿方面的限制而竞争的晋升以及附带条件的征聘候选人。 基准模型引入了性别特征或区分投入中缺失的属性,而Acmite则利用性别独立描述和决定标准继续了所要求的情景。 附录B提供了这些额外案例。 它们共同补充基准结果,表明Acmite在自由形式一代中减少了无支持的性别归属。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 2 isolates the two optimization terms with the training data, backbone, and router fixed, using the base model as reference. Full Acmite reduces the absolute ambiguous and disambiguated BBQ bias scores by 71.1% and 50.8%, respectively, while improving disambiguated accuracy by 0.7%. It also reduces the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet SS deviations from their ideal values by 37.9% and 17.5%, and improves ICAT by 8.8%, although ambiguous accuracy decreases by 3.1%.

blocks.en: Without ℒ MI \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MI}} , ambiguous BBQ bias improves by only 4.4%, disambiguated bias deteriorates by 36.4%, and StereoSet SS and ICAT improve by only 2.3% each. Removing ℒ dir \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dir}} retains substantial gains, but the full objective increases ambiguous-bias reduction from 33.3% to 71.1%, changes disambiguated accuracy from a 0.4% decrease to a 0.7% increase, and further improves StereoSet SS and ICAT. These benefits involve trade-offs in ambiguous accuracy and LMS, showing that the two terms contribute differently instead of improving every metric independently. Averaged over all eight metrics, full Acmite improves by 22.9%, compared with 18.3% without ℒ dir \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dir}} and 2.4% without ℒ MI \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MI}} ; the larger decline after removing ℒ MI \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MI}} supports its central role in the joint objective.

blocks.en: We additionally compare always-on and retrieval-guided inference on Phi-4-mini. Routing improves ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA from 57.51, 77.71, and 69.21 to 61.60, 81.20, and 76.93, respectively, while activating the adapter for only 0.96% of ARC-Challenge and GSM8K inputs and 9.25% of PIQA inputs. Thus, retrieval-guided activation largely prevents the debiasing adapter from altering bias-unrelated examples.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了关于Phi-4-mini的一贯和检索指导推论。 Routing改进了ARC-Challenge,GSM8K,以及PIQA,分别从57.51,77.71,69.21到61.60,81.20和76.93,同时激活适配器的只有0.96%的ARC-Challenge和GSM8K输入和9.25%的PIQA输入. 因此,检索制导的激活很大程度上防止了调离适配器改变与偏差无关的例子.

blocks.en: The threshold comparison further illustrates this trade-off. At τ = 0.55 \tau=0.55 , CrowS-Pairs SS is 58.13 and PIQA normalized accuracy is 75.35, with activation rates of 96.88% and 22.96%, respectively. At the selected threshold τ = 0.60 \tau=0.60 , Acmite obtains 55.63 on CrowS-Pairs, 66.54 ICAT, and a 73.24 average across the three general-capability tasks. On BBQ, it obtains ambiguous and disambiguated accuracies of 89.54 and 90.09, with bias scores of − 0.46 -0.46 and 0.58 0.58 . The lower threshold activates substantially more inputs but does not produce stronger CrowS-Pairs or PIQA results, showing that broader intervention is not necessarily more effective. These observations support using concept relevance to restrict adapter activation.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Acmite , a concept-guided framework for mitigating gender bias in large language models. Acmite moves beyond isolated correction targets by organizing biased expressions as reusable stereotype concepts and introducing concept-guided mutual information optimization to reduce their influence. Fair references guide optimization, while retrieval-based routing limits intervention to concept-relevant inputs. Across six benchmarks and three model families, Acmite reduces gender bias while maintaining competitive general capability.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Acmite,这是一个减轻大语言模式中的性别偏见的概念指导框架。 通过组织带有偏见的表达方式作为可重复使用的陈规定型概念,并引入以概念为指南的相互信息优化以减少其影响,Acmite超越了孤立的校正目标. 公平参考指南优化,而基于检索的路由限制干预与概念相关的投入. 在6个基准和3个模范家庭中,Acmite减少性别偏见,同时保持一般的竞争能力。

blocks.en: Our results yield two broader observations. First, low bias in question answering does not necessarily imply weak stereotypical associations, motivating evaluation across complementary formats. Second, shared concepts extracted from diverse bias examples can provide intervention signals for mutual information optimization, offering a viable concept-level alternative to instance-level preference-based debiasing.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果产生了两个更广泛的看法。 首先,在回答问题时的低偏差并不一定意味着薄弱的陈规定型协会,从而推动各种互补形式的评价。 其次,从各种偏见实例中提取的共同概念可以为相互信息优化提供干预信号,提供可行的概念层面替代基于实例的偏好疏导。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This work has two main limitations. First, our experiments focus exclusively on gender bias, and the effectiveness of Acmite on other socially sensitive attributes, such as race, religion, age, and their intersections, remains to be established. Second, following prior work and maintaining comparability with existing benchmarks, our experiments represent gender using binary categories. We recognize that gender identities are diverse and cannot be fully represented by a binary division; consequently, the present evaluation does not capture bias involving non-binary and other gender identities. Future work should extend both the concept database and evaluation protocol to broader social attributes and more inclusive representations of gender.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有两个主要局限。 第一,我们的实验完全侧重于性别偏见,而Acmite对其他社会敏感属性,如种族、宗教、年龄及其交叉点的有效性仍有待确定。 第二,遵循先前的工作,并保持与现有基准的可比性,我们的实验采用二进制类别表示性别。 我们认识到,性别认同是多种多样的,不能用二进制划分来充分代表;因此,本评价没有反映涉及非二进制和其他性别认同的偏见。 今后的工作应扩大概念数据库和评价程序,使之包括更广泛的社会属性和更具包容性的性别代表。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work aims to identify and mitigate social bias in large language models; it does not endorse or reproduce stereotypical associations. The stereotype concept database is constructed from existing bias datasets and therefore contains potentially offensive or harmful statements. These statements are used only as intervention signals for research purposes and should not be interpreted as factual descriptions of any social group.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在查明和减轻大语言模式的社会偏见;它不认可或复制陈规定型的社团。 定型观念概念数据库是根据现有的偏差数据集构建的,因此包含可能冒犯或有害的说法。 这些言论仅用作用于研究目的的干预信号,不应解释为对任何社会群体的事实描述。

blocks.en: We use an external large language model to assist with concept extraction, neutral-output auditing, and rewriting. Although this process reduces manual annotation requirements, automatically generated concepts and revisions may still reflect model-specific biases or errors. We therefore use structured prompts and consistent processing criteria throughout data construction. Our experiments do not involve human participants or the collection of new personal information.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一种外部的大语言模型来协助概念提取、中性输出审计和重写。 尽管这一过程减少了人工注释的要求,但自动生成的概念和修改仍然可能反映模型特有的偏差或错误. 因此,我们在整个数据构建过程中都采用结构化提示和一致的处理标准。 我们的实验不涉及人类参与者或收集新的个人信息。
